question: How should participants be selected when the full mūrti circle is unavailable?
premises: Participants may be engaged without prior arrangement.
They are identified through the recitation of deity names.
If the mūrti circle cannot be obtained, only maidens should be worshipped.
inference: The rite allows spontaneous selection by sacred utterance, with maiden-worship as the fallback when the full circle is absent.
uncertainties: The ritual criteria for recognizing suitable participants through deity-name recitation are not detailed.
plain_english: Participants may be brought in without prior arrangement through the recitation of deity names; but if the mūrti circle cannot be obtained, one should worship only maidens.
